name: 透
text:
────え、もう回ってる？
ごめんごめん
trans:
────Eh, it's recording already?
Sorry, my bad.

name: 透
text: 新年、明けまして──
trans: Wishing everyone──

name: 一同
text: おめでとうございます
trans: A Happy New Year!

name: 円香
text: 今年もお世話になります
trans:
We look forward to another year of your
continued support.

name: 小糸
text:
み、みなさんは
どんなお正月を過ごしましたか？
trans: H-How is everyone spending your New Year's Day?

name: 雛菜
text:
雛菜たちはね
これから着付けしてもらって初詣行く～
trans:
We're gonna get ourselves dolled up formally, then
head in for our New Year's shrine visitation!

name: 透
text: じゃ、行こ
trans: Alrigh, let's go.

name: 円香＆小糸＆雛菜
text: ん
trans: Yea.

name: 小糸
text: 雪、ちょっと降ってる……
trans: It's snowing, a little...

name: 雛菜
text: あは～、やっぱり混んでるね～
trans: Aha～ The shrine sure is crowded～

name: 円香
text: ……とりあえず、お参りと絵馬くらいはこなそう
trans:
...Anyway, I think we can shoot ourselves offering
our prayers and writing some wishing tablets.

name: 円香
text:
振袖、経費で着せてもらってるし
せめて撮れ高がないと
trans:
The rental and fitting of the furisode are covered by
expenses, so we should get some good shots and
make the most of it.

name: 雛菜
text: じゃあ雛菜、先にあったかいドリンク買ってくる～
trans: In that case, Hinana will go get some warm drinks then～

name: 小糸
text:
あ、じゃあ、わたしは
みんなでつまめそうなもの、買ってくるね！
trans: Ah, then, I'll go buy some food we can all share!

name: 円香
text: ……後で合流で
trans: ...Let's meet up in a bit.

name: 透
text: オッケー
trans: Okaay.

name: 円香
text: 二拝二拍手一拝
trans: Two bows, two claps, and one bow.

name: 円香
text: 願いは
trans: My wish

name: 円香
text: 願わない
trans: Isn’t something to be wished for

name: 小糸
text: 絵馬、ひとつでよかったよね……？
trans: Should we just write on one wishing tablet...?

name: 透
text:
あ、うん
ありがと、小糸ちゃん
trans:
Ah, yeah.
Thanks Koito-chan.

name: 雛菜
text:
絵馬か～
何書く～？
trans:
Wishing tablets, huh～
What should we write～?

name: 小糸
text:
ノクチルみんなのお願い事でもいいし……
寄せ書きみたいにしてもいいかも……
trans:
Maybe we can write what every member of
noctchill wishes for... Or maybe a group message
is good too...

name: 透
text:
願い事かー……
え、ある？
trans:
What we wish for, huhー...
Eh, you guys have any?

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～……
雛菜のことは雛菜が叶えられるけど……
trans:
Hm～... Hinana can make her own wishes come
true, but...

name: 雛菜
text: ノクチルのはわかんないかも～……
trans:
I'm not very sure when it comes to noctchill's
wishes...

name: 透
text:
じゃあ──
『ノクチルが来た』ってだけ
trans:
Then how 'bout──
We just write "noctchill's been here".

name: 透
text: えっと──
trans: Let's see──

name: 透
text: 『ノクチル』……
trans: "noctchill"...

name: 小糸
text: さ、『参拝』とかどうかな……？
trans: H-How about, "here to visit"......?

name: 透
text: おー、いいね
trans: Ooh, yes that's good.

name: 透
trans: "Here"... Ah.

name: 円香＆小糸＆雛菜
text: あ
trans: Ah.

name: 円香
text:
……まあ良いんじゃない？
自己主張強めだけど
trans:
...Well, I suppose that's fine?
It feels a bit self-assertive though.

name: 円香
text: ────じゃ、それこっちに向けて
trans:
────Alright then, put it facing this way.
(Wish tablet: "noctchill, here we come")

name: 透
text: うん
trans: Yea.

name: 雛菜
text:
あ～
透先輩、顔にインク付いちゃってるよ～
trans:
Ah～
There's a blob of ink on your face～

name: 小糸
text: ほ、ほんとだ……！
trans: A-Ah, I see it too...!

name: 透
text: え、どこ？
trans: Eh, where?

name: 円香
text:
……以上、ノクチルの初詣でした
みなさんもよいお年を
trans:
...And that concludes noctchill's New Year's shrine
visitation. Have a good year ahead, everyone.

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
混んでたけど楽しかった～♡
trans:
Aha～ 
The place was packed but it was still super fun～♡

name: 円香
text:
一応撮影はできたけど……
正直もうこりごり
trans:
At least the shoot's done and all...
but honestly I'm pretty tired of it all.

name: 円香
text: 周りの人とか振袖とか、気を配ることばっかりで
trans:
Having to constantly be mindful of the crowd, not
dirtying furisode and all that.

name: 透
text: ……取れた？
trans: ...Did it come off?

name: 小糸
text:
う、ううん
それ、油性だったのかも……
trans:
N-No it didn't.
M-Maybe it was permanant ink...

name: 円香
text:
振袖から着替えたついでに
落とせばよかったんじゃない
trans:
You should have cleaned it off when you changed out
of the furisode.

name: 透
text: ふふ、忘れてて
trans: Fufu, I forget.

name: 雛菜
text:
あとでクレンジングシートあげる～
ちゃんと取れるといいね～
trans:
I'll get you some cleaning wipes in a bit～
We better get it off properly～

name: 透
text: あざす
trans: Thank.

name: 円香
text:
……カメラ、これで一周回ったから
このままついでに事務所まで持って行っちゃうね
trans:
...Now that the camera's come a full circle back to
me, I'll just go drop it off at the office.

name: 透
text:
お
じゃあ私も
trans:
Oh,
I wanna tag along.

name: 雛菜
text:
あ、雛菜、焼き芋食べたい～！
事務所の途中の道にあった気がする～
trans:
Ah, Hinana wants to eat some roasted sweet
potatoes～! There should be a store selling them 
on the way to the office～

name: 小糸
text:
い、いいね……！
焼き芋食べながら寄り道……！
trans:
T-That's sounds good...!
Let's stop by while we eat..!

name: 円香
text:
知らないし、焼き芋売ってるとこなんか
雛菜先導よろしく
trans:
I don't know if there's such a stall, but lead the way,
Hinana.

name: 雛菜
text: あは～、了解です～！
trans: Aha～ Roger that～
